select p.polygon_id, p.polygon_no, p.polygon_points, p.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then d.device_name else ten.device_name end) deviceName, p.channel_code, (case when length(IFNULL(ten.channel_name, '')) = 0 then a.channel_name else ten.channel_name end) channelName, p.preset_id, p.preset_name, p.layer_id, p.layer_name, p.feature_id, p.tbbh from vm_polygon_patch_config p left join vm_device_info_t d on p.device_code = d.device_code and d.delete_flag = 0 inner join vm_order_devices ord on p.device_code = ord.device_code and p.tenant_id = ord.tenant_id and p.industry_code = ord.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t a on p.device_code = a.device_code and p.channel_code = a.channel_code and a.delete_flag = 0 left join vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = p.device_code and ten.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and ten.delete_flag='0' and ten.industry_code = p.industry_code where ord.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and ord.delete_flag = 0
and
(p.layer_id = #{item.layerId} and p.feature_id = #{item.featureId})
and p.layer_id = #{param.layerId} and p.feature_id = #{param.featureId}
and p.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} and p.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and p.delete_flag = 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_inspection_route ( inspection_route_name, pause_cruise_flag, route_status, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code, creator, create_time, delete_flag ) values ( #{param.inspectionRouteName}, #{param.pauseCruiseFlag}, #{param.routeStatus}, #{param.tenantId}, #{param.industryCode}, #{param.appVerCode}, #{param.creator}, now(), '0' )
mapper.select: select * from sys_inspection_route_fence_rel where id = #{id}

select rel.device_code, r.`pause_cruise_flag` from sys_inspection_route r inner join sys_inspection_route_fence_rel rel on r.id = rel.inspection_route_id where r.id = #{id} and rel.route_status = 1 limit 1
select * from sys_inspection_route_fence_rel where inspection_route_id = #{inspectionRouteId} and route_status = #{routeStatus} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_inspection_route_fence_rel set route_status = 0, modifier = #{param.modifier}, update_time = #{param.updateTime}, inspection_start_time = null, pause_start_time = null, pause_time = 0 where inspection_route_id = #{param.inspectionRouteId}

update sys_inspection_route_fence_rel set route_status = 1, modifier = #{param.modifier}, update_time = #{param.updateTime}, pause_time = pause_time + (unix_timestamp(#{param.updateTime}) - unix_timestamp(pause_start_time)) where inspection_route_id = #{param.inspectionRouteId} and id = #{param.inspectionRouteSubId} and route_status in (0, 2)

update sys_inspection_route_fence_rel set route_status = 1, modifier = #{param.modifier}, update_time = #{param.updateTime}, inspection_start_time = #{param.updateTime}, pause_start_time = null, pause_time = 0 where inspection_route_id = #{param.inspectionRouteId} and id = #{param.inspectionRouteSubId}

update sys_inspection_route_fence_rel set route_status = #{routeStatus}, modifier = #{param.modifier}, update_time = #{param.updateTime}, inspection_start_time = null, pause_start_time = null where inspection_route_id = #{param.inspectionRouteId} and id != #{param.inspectionRouteSubId}
mapper.select: select rel.* from sys_inspection_route_fence_rel rel inner join vm_order_devices o on rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.device_code = o.device_code where rel.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} and rel.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and rel.inspection_route_id = #{param.inspectionRouteId} and o.ord_status in (0,1,2) and o.delete_flag = 0 order by rel.sort_seq limit 1

select r.id inspectionRouteId, r.inspection_route_name inspectionRouteName, r.route_status routeStatus, group_concat(distinct(l.layer_name)) layerNames, group_concat(distinct(l.custom_name)) customNames, count(distinct rel.feature_id) plotNum
from sys_inspection_route r inner join sys_inspection_route_fence_rel rel on r.id = rel.inspection_route_id inner join sys_layer l on rel.layer_id = l.id inner join vm_order_devices o on rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.device_code = o.device_code where r.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} and r.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and r.delete_flag = 0 and o.ord_status in (0,1,2) and o.delete_flag = 0
and r.inspection_route_name like concat('%', #{param.inspectionRouteName}, '%')
${param.dataPermissions}
